form_fields.name: ENV_KAFKA_VERSION
form_fields.label: 版本
form_fields.description: 指定当前程序的版本详情
form_fields.guide_short: Kafka 客户端协议版本，例如 2.0.0；该值必须与 Broker 兼容，页面示例不是默认值。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Kafka client protocol version, such as 2.0.0. It must be compatible with the broker; the value shown on the page is an example, not a default.

form_fields.name: ENV_SASL_ENABLED
form_fields.label: 启用认证
form_fields.description: 是否启用 SASL 认证（用户名和密码）
form_fields.guide_short: 是否启用 SASL 认证。开启后下发 sasl.enabled；关闭时空串。Kafka SASL 默认走 PLAIN。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Controls SASL authentication. Enabling it passes sasl.enabled; disabling it passes an empty value. The exporter uses PLAIN when no other SASL mechanism is specified.

form_fields.name: ENV_SASL_USERNAME
form_fields.label: 用户名
form_fields.description: 用于访问接口的用户名
form_fields.guide_short: 启用认证时必填的 SASL 用户名；必须与 Broker 上配置的认证主体及 ACL 匹配。
form_fields.guide_short_en: SASL username required when authentication is enabled. It must match a principal and ACL configuration on the broker.

form_fields.name: ENV_SASL_PASSWORD
form_fields.label: 密码
form_fields.guide_short: SASL 密码。含 # @ 等特殊字符务必通过 password 字段下发，不要拼到 SASL_USERNAME 或其他 ENV。
form_fields.guide_short_en: SASL password. Supply values containing characters such as # or @ through this password field; do not append them to SASL_USERNAME or another environment value.

form_fields.name: ENV_SASL_MECHANISM
form_fields.label: 运行机制
form_fields.description: 用于处理和响应通过发布端口接收的请求，包括请求的解析、处理和返回结果的完整流程
form_fields.guide_short: SASL 机制：plain / sha256 / sha512 / gssapi；不填走 PLAIN。AKS/Strimzi 部署需 KafkaUser 的 authentication.type 与之匹配。
form_fields.guide_short_en: SASL mechanism: plain, sha256, sha512, or gssapi. An empty value uses PLAIN. For AKS or Strimzi, match the KafkaUser authentication.type.

form_fields.name: ENV_LISTEN_PORT
form_fields.label: 监听端口
form_fields.description: 指定程序运行时应监听的端口号，用于接受外部请求和连接
form_fields.guide_short: kafka_exporter 在采集节点本地暴露 /metrics 的端口；页面无默认值，需显式填写。多实例必须分配不同端口，且不要与 Broker 端口混淆。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Local port where kafka_exporter exposes /metrics on the collector node. The page has no default, so enter it explicitly. Use a unique port per instance and do not confuse it with a broker port.

form_fields.name: ENV_KAFKA_SERVER
form_fields.label: 服务器地址
form_fields.description: 监控对象的服务器地址
form_fields.guide_short: Kafka Broker 的 host:port，如 kafka:9092；broker 必须能被访问到 advertised.listeners 设的地址，否则 exporter 报 no advertised brokers。
form_fields.guide_short_en: One Kafka broker in host:port form, such as kafka:9092. The exporter must also be able to reach the address advertised by the broker, or it may report no advertised brokers.

form_fields.name: ENV_TOPIC_FILTER
form_fields.label: Topic包含
form_fields.description: 按正则包含要采集的 Topic
form_fields.guide_short: Topic 包含正则，默认 .*；regex 不匹配将不出维度。topic 数量大时用前缀如 ^prod_ 减少开销。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Regular expression for included topics; the default is .*. Topics that do not match are omitted. For many topics, use a prefix such as ^prod_ to reduce collection cost.

form_fields.name: ENV_TOPIC_EXCLUDE
form_fields.label: Topic排除
form_fields.description: 按正则排除不需要采集的 Topic
form_fields.guide_short: Topic 排除正则，默认 ^$（不排除）；例如 ^_internal 排除系统内部 topic。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Regular expression for excluded topics; the default ^$ excludes nothing. For example, ^_internal excludes internal topics.

form_fields.name: ENV_GROUP_FILTER
form_fields.label: 消费组包含
form_fields.description: 按正则包含要采集的消费组
form_fields.guide_short: 消费组包含正则，默认 .*；按需用 ^prod_ 等前缀收敛。账号需 Describe Group 权限。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Regular expression for included consumer groups; the default is .*. Narrow it with a prefix such as ^prod_ when needed. The account requires Describe Group permission.

form_fields.name: ENV_GROUP_EXCLUDE
form_fields.label: 消费组排除
form_fields.description: 按正则排除不需要采集的消费组
form_fields.guide_short: 消费组排除正则，默认 ^$；例如 ^test- 排除测试组。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Regular expression for excluded consumer groups; the default is ^$. For example, ^test- excludes test groups.

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 间隔
form_fields.description: 监控数据的采集时间间隔（单位：秒）
form_fields.guide_short: Telegraf inputs.prometheus 抓取周期，单位秒，默认 60；不要小于 10 防止 Describe Group 高频请求影响 broker。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Telegraf inputs.prometheus scrape interval in seconds; the default is 60. Avoid values below 10 to prevent frequent Describe Group requests from affecting the broker.
